svg.aria-label: Share with the team: Commit the same setup to the project's .claude/settings.json, so everyone who trusts the folder gets the skills. The exact JSON is in REFERENCE.md. One profile per repo: Run the wizard once per repo and commit the resulting .claude/stack-profile.md. Validate: bash scripts/validate.sh checks every marketplace entry, the shared version, catalogue ownership, every SKILL.md, and every relative .md link under skills/. CI: CI runs the same script on every pull request
